# Agentic AI from Scratch

> Build AI agents from a raw while-loop and an HTTP call, before a single framework gets imported. 16 phases, 163 lessons (137 live), Python and TypeScript, free and open source (MIT).

Source: https://github.com/Ramakm/agentic-ai-from-scratch
Site: https://agentic-ai-from-scratch.vercel.app/
Maintainer: Ramakrushna Mohapatra (https://www.linkedin.com/in/ramakrushnamohapatra, https://www.instagram.com/techwith.ram/, https://x.com/techwith_ram, https://github.com/Ramakm)

Install the tutor skills into a coding agent: npx skills add Ramakm/agentic-ai-from-scratch

## Phase 00: Setup & Tooling

A dev environment, local and hosted models, raw HTTP calls, streaming and tracing, all wired up before writing an agent.

- 13.07 Versioning prompts and tools (40 min) [planned]

Streaming step views, approvals and undo, voice, background agents, and the design of trust.

Everything at once. A loop, tool registry, memory, MCP, subagents, permissions, and evals, shipped as a CLI.

## Interview questions

- The agent takes a different path every run, even at temperature 0 (level 1 Fundamentals, Concept): https://agentic-ai-from-scratch.vercel.app/interviews/llm-foundations/different-answer-every-run/
